mapper.select: /* BmsPkgNoMapper.selectBmsPkgNoListByInPlanNo : 박스번호 리스트 - 반입예정번호(inPlanNo)로 조회 */ SELECT A.BL_NO , A.MBL_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.EX_CT , PKG.PACKING_NO , PKG.DELETE_YN , PKG.NEW_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , PKG.IN_PLAN_NO , PKG.SEQ FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN A WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG PKG ON PKG.IN_PLAN_NO = A.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE A.IN_PLAN_NO = #{srchNo}

/* BmsPkgNoMapper.selectBmsPkgNoListExistPlanByInPlanNo : 박스번호 리스트 - 반입예정번호(InPlanNo)로 반입예정이 있는 경우 조회 */ SELECT A.BL_NO , A.MBL_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.EX_CT , PKG.PACKING_NO , PKG.DELETE_YN , PKG.NEW_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , PKG.IN_PLAN_NO , PKG.SEQ FROM TB_BMS_IN A WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG PKG WITH (NOLOCK) ON PKG.IN_PLAN_NO = A.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{cargoReferenceNo}
AND A.IN_PLAN_NO > 0

/* BmsPkgNoMapper.selectBmsPkgNoListExistPlanByOrigInPlanNo : 박스번호 리스트 - 반입예정번호(inPlanNo)로 반입예정이 있는 경우 조회 */ SELECT A.BL_NO , A.MBL_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.EX_CT , PKG.PACKING_NO , PKG.DELETE_YN , PKG.NEW_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , PKG.IN_PLAN_NO , PKG.SEQ FROM TB_BMS_IN A WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG PKG WITH (NOLOCK) ON PKG.IN_PLAN_NO = A.ORIG_IN_PLAN_NO WHERE A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{cargoReferenceNo} AND A.IN_CLASS = '21' AND A.ORIG_IN_PLAN_NO > 0

/* BmsPkgNoMapper.selectBmsPkgNoListByInNo : 박스번호 리스트 - 반입번호(inNo)로 조회 */ SELECT A.BL_NO , A.MBL_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.EX_CT , PKG.PACKING_NO , PKG.DELETE_YN , PKG.NEW_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , PKG.IN_PLAN_NO , PKG.SEQ FROM TB_BMS_IN A WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG PKG ON PKG.IN_PLAN_NO = A.IN_PLAN_NO OR PKG.IN_PLAN_NO = A.ORIG_IN_PLAN_NO WHERE A.IN_NO = #{srchNo}
mapper.insert: /* BmsPkgNoMapper.batchInsertPkgByInPlanNo : 반입예정번호로 박스 리스트 조회 */ INSERT INTO TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG ( IN_PLAN_NO , BL_NO , PACKING_NO , PACKING_CT , DIM_WIDTH , DIM_LENGTH , DIM_HEIGHT , WEIGHING_WT , IN_CT , OUT_CT , SAMPLE_IN_CT , SAMPLE_OUT_CT , MOVE_IN_CT , MOVE_OUT_CT , RETURN_IN_CT , RETURN_OUT_CT , LOCATION_PLACE , LOCATION_STATUS , INSPECT_STATUS , DELETE_YN , REGISTER_USER_ID , REGISTER_DATE_TIME , UPDATE_USER_ID , UPDATE_DATE_TIME ) SELECT IN_PLAN_NO , BL_NO , PACKING_NO + CAST(FLOOR(RAND() * 90) + 10 AS VARCHAR) , 1 , DIM_WIDTH , DIM_LENGTH , DIM_HEIGHT , WEIGHING_WT , 1 , OUT_CT , SAMPLE_IN_CT , SAMPLE_OUT_CT , MOVE_IN_CT , MOVE_OUT_CT , RETURN_IN_CT , RETURN_OUT_CT , LOCATION_PLACE , LOCATION_STATUS , INSPECT_STATUS , DELETE_YN , REGISTER_USER_ID , REGISTER_DATE_TIME , #{updateUserId} , GETDATE() FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = #{inPlanNo} AND DELETE_YN = 'N'
